mapper.select:
select a.*,count(1) as count from (select tpp.id as plan_id, tcp.project_code, tcp.project_name, tps.procurement_plan_type as procurement_type_code, tps.procurement_type from tb_procurement_plan tpp LEFT JOIN tb_contract_planning tcp on tcp.plan_id = tpp.id LEFT JOIN tb_procurement_scheme_plan_relate tpspr on tpp.id = tpspr.procurement_plan_id LEFT JOIN tb_procurement_scheme tps on tpspr.procurement_scheme_id = tps.id LEFT JOIN tb_tender_notice ttn on tps.id = ttn.scheme_id LEFT JOIN (select * from tb_bidding_result where bid_result = '1') tbr on ttn.id = tbr.notice_id
ttn.notice_status = '8'
AND tbr.notifi_time >= #{startTime} AND tbr.notifi_time <= #{endTime}
group by tpp.id )a group by a.project_code, a.plan_id, a.procurement_type_code, a.procurement_type
